race.comment: CELESTIAL SPLENDOR (10) is coming off a dominant win at Kilmore in a BM56, scoring by three lengths. Enjoyed the better surface there and can measure up to this slightly tougher contest. THE FLYING POPOV (5) has been okay in three runs back, in the market at Pakenham last time over 1400m. He's crying out for ground and the rise to a mile suits much better. MISTER MARTINI (8) struggled at Morphettville last time but had been good prior here and can improve from a soft draw. AUBAINE (7) is racing consistently this time in, just finding one better at Kyneton last start. He'll be up on speed for Meech who rates them well.
